secrets.name: POLYPACK_APPLE_APP_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Apple ID app-specific password passed to notarytool (never the account password).

variables.name: POLYPACK_IOS_IDENTITY
variables.description: Apple Distribution identity used for codesign -s (non-secret).

variables.name: POLYPACK_IOS_TEAM_ID
variables.description: Apple Developer Team ID (non-secret).

variables.name: POLYPACK_APPLE_ID
variables.description: Apple ID email used as the notarytool --apple-id argument.

request.zh: 需要组织持有的 Apple Developer 账号、Apple Distribution 证书与 notarytool 凭据；在 macos-14 runner 上执行，无需物理设备。
request.en: Needs the organization's Apple Developer account, Apple Distribution certificate and notarytool credentials; runs on a macos-14 runner, no physical device.

variables.name: POLYPACK_IOS_IDENTITY
variables.description: Apple Distribution identity available on the macOS farm worker (non-secret).

variables.name: POLYPACK_IOS_TEAM_ID
variables.description: Apple Developer Team ID used by the farm worker (non-secret).

request.zh: 需要一台物理 macOS 主机（完整 Xcode）与 Linux 发起机共享同路径农场目录；托管 Linux runner 不能替代。
request.en: Needs a physical macOS host (full Xcode) sharing a same-path farm directory with the Linux submitter; a hosted Linux runner cannot substitute.

title.zh: 微信 / 支付宝 / 抖音开发者工具预览

secrets.name: POLYPACK_WECHAT_DEVTOOLS_LOGIN
secrets.description: Exported WeChat DevTools login state consumed by miniprogram-contract.

secrets.name: POLYPACK_ALIPAY_DEVTOOLS_LOGIN
secrets.description: Exported Alipay Mini Program Studio login state consumed by miniprogram-contract.

secrets.name: POLYPACK_DOUYIN_DEVTOOLS_LOGIN
secrets.description: Exported Douyin DevTools login state consumed by miniprogram-contract.

variables.name: POLYPACK_WECHAT_DEVTOOLS_CLI
variables.description: Path to the WeChat DevTools CLI on the runner (vars.POLYPACK_WECHAT_DEVTOOLS_CLI).

variables.name: POLYPACK_ALIPAY_DEVTOOLS_CLI
variables.description: Path to Alipay minidev on the runner (vars.POLYPACK_ALIPAY_DEVTOOLS_CLI).

variables.name: POLYPACK_DOUYIN_DEVTOOLS_CLI
variables.description: Path to the Douyin tma CLI on the runner (vars.POLYPACK_DOUYIN_DEVTOOLS_CLI).

variables.name: POLYPACK_DEVTOOLS_LOGIN_FILE
variables.description: Path to the materialized devtools login file; Alipay also uses ALIPAY_IDENTITY_KEY_PATH.

label.zh: 支付宝小程序开发者工具

request.zh: 需要 macOS 上的三端开发者工具与已登录账号（扫码 / 2FA）；登录态由人工准备，仓库只保存 secret 登录文件。
request.en: Needs all three devtools and logged-in accounts (QR / 2FA) on macOS; a human prepares the login state and the repo stores only the secret login file.

slots.docs: docs/ENV-SLOTS.md#env-04--微信--支付宝--抖音开发者工具预览

secrets.name: ROKU_DEV_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Roku developer-mode device password used by the ECP sideload leg.

variables.name: ROKU_DEV_TARGET
variables.description: Roku device IP address on the same LAN as the host.

request.zh: 需要局域网内开启开发者模式的真实 Roku 设备与设备 IP / 开发者密码；托管 runner 无设备网络。
request.en: Needs a real Roku in developer mode on the local network plus its IP and developer password; hosted runners have no device network.

request.zh: 需要支持 KVM 的 self-hosted runner（或物理 OpenBSD 主机）；无仓库凭据，首绿后移除 continue-on-error。
request.en: Needs a KVM-capable self-hosted runner (or physical OpenBSD host); no repo credentials, remove continue-on-error after the first green run.

variables.name: POLYPACK_QNX_SDP
variables.description: Absolute path to the QNX SDP 7.1 tree on a self-hosted runner (vars.POLYPACK_QNX_SDP).

variables.name: POLYPACK_QNX_QEMU
variables.description: Optional qemu-system-x86_64 path for the QNX smoke leg.

variables.name: POLYPACK_QNX_QEMU_ARGS
variables.description: Optional extra QEMU arguments for the QNX smoke leg.

request.zh: 需要自托管 runner 安装 QNX SDP 7.1 与商业许可证；许可证不能公开下载进托管 runner。
request.en: Needs a self-hosted runner with QNX SDP 7.1 and a commercial license; the license cannot be publicly downloaded onto a hosted runner.

variables.name: WR_CC
variables.description: Path to the Wind River wr-cc compiler on a self-hosted runner.

variables.name: POLYPACK_VXWORKS_TRIPLE
variables.description: Target triple for the VxWorks link leg (default x86_64-wrs-vxworks).

request.zh: 需要自托管 runner 安装 Wind River Workbench / VxWorks 7 SDK 与商业许可证。
request.en: Needs a self-hosted runner with Wind River Workbench / VxWorks 7 SDK and a commercial license.

title.zh: Wear OS 设备 / 模拟器冒烟

variables.name: POLYPACK_WEAR_FORM_APK
variables.description: Path to the prebuilt Wear form APK (vars.POLYPACK_WEAR_FORM_APK).

variables.name: POLYPACK_WEAR_FORM_PACKAGE
variables.description: Wear form package id (default com.polypack.weatform).

request.zh: 需要 /dev/kvm 的 self-hosted runner 或已 ADB 授权的物理 Wear OS 设备，以及预构建表单 APK。
request.en: Needs a self-hosted runner with /dev/kvm or a physical Wear OS device with ADB authorization, plus the prebuilt form APK.

request.zh: 模拟器安装是 GUI 人工腿；需桌面宿主手动装入 .zab 并截图，agent / headless runner 不能代替。
request.en: Simulator install is a manual GUI leg; a desktop host must install the .zab and capture a screenshot; an agent or headless runner cannot substitute.

title.zh: Garmin Connect IQ SDK / devkey 编译
title.en: Garmin Connect IQ SDK / devkey build

secrets.name: POLYPACK_GARMIN_DEVKEY_B64
secrets.description: Pilot name: base64 of developer_key.der; CI must decode it to a runner-local file and point CIQ_DEVKEY at that path. No workflow consumes it yet.

variables.name: CIQ_HOME
variables.description: Connect IQ SDK root on the runner.

variables.name: CONNECTIQ_HOME
variables.description: Legacy alias for the Connect IQ SDK root.

variables.name: CIQ_MONKEYC
variables.description: Explicit path to monkeyc (takes precedence over CIQ_HOME).

variables.name: CIQ_DEVKEY
variables.description: Runner-local path to the .der developer key materialized from POLYPACK_GARMIN_DEVKEY_B64.

label.zh: Garmin Connect IQ SDK 下载

request.zh: 需要 Connect IQ SDK（可能需 Garmin 账号）与开发者生成的 .der devkey；devkey 只以 secret 注入并由 runner 解码到本地文件。
request.en: Needs the Connect IQ SDK (Garmin account may be required) and a developer-generated .der devkey; inject the devkey only as a secret and decode it on the runner.

request.zh: 需要招募 3–5 名外部开发者，在干净的 Linux / macOS / Windows 机器上按 GA §2 试用并提交报告；纯人工流程。
request.en: Needs 3–5 external developers to trial GA §2 on clean Linux / macOS / Windows machines and submit reports; a purely human process.

title.zh: 真机设备预览（Android + Android TV）

request.zh: 需要真实 Android 手机 + Android TV（或云设备农场账号）与 adb 授权；dry-run 已交付，真实安装 / 截图未执行。
request.en: Needs a real Android phone + Android TV (or a cloud device-farm account) and adb authorization; dry-run is delivered, real install / screenshots are not.
